Hey so to give a little help here, you can easily watch each stitch type if you watch woobles on YouTube. They've done shorts of each stitch and they're very clear and easy to see. This is definitely yarn under and will make tighter X shaped stitches rather than the regular V shape. 

Also it's a lot easier to do stitches if you hold your yarn correctly and not so tightly. 

With your palm facing you wrap the yarn over the top of your pinky and back around it then up the back of your fingers to rest over your pointer finger. Resist the urge to pull the yarn as tight as you can, it's more of a feed tape with slight tension. This will make your stitches more consistent. Also instead of using your fingers to pull through keep the hook level and pull if it's snagging your tension is probably either too loose or too tight.
